name: Seamless Panes
summary: Takes the frame lines off clear glass and glass panes, so windows read as one clean surface.
logoPrompt: A single clear glass block with no frame, only two small white glints on its face, floating in the centre

bullets: No frame lines on clear glass

description: **Seamless Panes removes the light blue frame from every clear glass block, so a wall of glass looks like one big window.**
- Clear glass blocks lose the frame lines that turn every window into a grid.
- Glass panes share this texture, so their faces are clean too; only the thin edge you see from the side stays.
- The two small diagonal glints on each face stay, so you still see where the glass is and do not walk into it.
- Keeps the original 16x look: nothing is redrawn, only the frame is taken away.
Put the zip into the `resourcepacks` folder of your game, then turn it on under Options > Resource Packs.
- Resource pack for Minecraft: Java Edition 1.21, 1.21.1 and 26.3. It only changes how glass looks, so you can add or remove it at any time.
- Stained and tinted glass keep their usual look for now. The glass shell of a beacon uses the same texture and looks clearer too.
- The glass icon in your inventory looks almost empty too.
- New features arrive with updates, see each file's changelog.
Found a spot where the glass looks wrong? Leave a comment.
